title: Roundful premium-content manifest
description: The contract between this repo and the iOS app. The app fetches manifest.json once per launch (cached ~1h, stale-while-revalidate) to learn what additional articles exist without paying per-article HTTP. Body .md files are fetched lazily when the user taps an article.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking changes. Apps ignore manifests with a version they don't understand.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp stamped by build_manifest.py. Ends with 'Z'.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum iOS app version (semver) that understands the feature set used by articles in this manifest. Older apps will ignore this manifest.

id.description: Stable identifier. Matches the .md filename stem. 3-digit numeric prefix + kebab-case slug, e.g. '001-meal-timing'.

order.description: Sort key in the Insights list. 1-99 reserved for in-app bundled articles; remote articles start at 100.

tier.description: App may gate 'premium' behind an entitlement. All articles ship as 'free' for now.

category.description: Free-form tag; v1 sticks to the five existing app categories.

minutesRead.description: Author's estimate of reading time in minutes.

updatedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Used by the app for per-article cache busting. Bump this when you edit the body.

translations.description: Keyed by BCP-47 locale. 'en' is required; 'zh-Hans' strongly recommended. The app falls back to 'en' for any missing locale.

title.description: Display title. Pulled from frontmatter by build_manifest.py.

summary.description: One-line teaser for the list view. Keep under ~120 chars; hard-capped at 200.

path.description: Path to the body .md relative to the repo root. The app prepends the Pages base URL.
